hook_strength_notes: This hook uses a bold claim about losing money to instantly trigger curiosity and high emotional stakes audio-first.

scenes.narration: Your free stock app is secretly built to make you lose.
scenes.visual_description: A hand holding a smartphone showing a red stock chart dropping rapidly

scenes.narration: Basic charts are free, but real-time data is locked behind a paywall.
scenes.visual_description: Screen recording of tapping a locked feature on a stock app with a pop-up price tag

scenes.narration: That’s because live exchange feeds cost millions, so they push the price onto you.
scenes.visual_description: Extreme closeup of a finger hitting a glowing red Subscribe button on phone screen

scenes.narration: Meaning you're making trades using fifteen-minute-delayed prices.
scenes.visual_description: A digital clock ticking backwards rapidly next to a flickering stock ticker

scenes.narration: Ditch the paid upgrade and use free browser screeners instead.
scenes.visual_description: A laptop screen opening a free desktop stock screener dashboard with green charts
